title: Pochta yoki kuryer: bir xil buyurtma — boshqa boj
caption: 📮 Bir xil buyurtma: pochtada 288 468 so'm, kuryerda — 0 Bojsiz norma kanalga qarab ikki xil: • Pochta orqali — oyiga 100 $ • Kuryer orqali — oyiga 200 $ 🧮 Misol: bojxona qiymati (tovar + yo'l) — 150 $ 📮 Pochta orqali • Normadan ortig'i: 150 − 100 = 50 $ • Boj 30 %: 50 × 30 % = 15 $ ≈ 178 468 so'm • 1 ta BKO uchun yig'im — 110 000 so'm • Jami: 288 468 so'm 🚚 Kuryer orqali • 150 $ < 200 $ — norma ichida, boj yo'q ✅ 💡 Qoida: buyurtma (tovar + yo'l) 100 $ dan oshsa — yetkazish usulini oldindan tanlang. prompt:
Create a vertical 4:5 cover image for a Telegram channel post. Clean, modern 3D-minimal style, calm and trustworthy. Pure white background with one large soft lavender (#EEEEFC) rounded shape behind the upper half.

1) Top-left: a small solid indigo (#4F46E5) rounded pill with white bold text "#boj".
2) Center: two identical cardboard parcels side by side: the left one on a classic postal mailbox with a small amber coin stack beside it, the right one on a small courier delivery van with a green check mark badge. Render it as a soft 3D clay illustration with matte surfaces in white and indigo (#4F46E5) with small touches of emerald green (#059669); soft studio lighting, gentle shadows, generous space around it.
3) Below the illustration: a large bold near-black (#11111B) headline, at most two lines: "Pochta yoki kuryer?"
4) Under the headline, a smaller medium-grey line: "Norma: 100 $ va 200 $"
5) Bottom, above a thin light divider: left bold near-black "@Pochtam_shopo".

One geometric sans-serif font family throughout (Poppins / Montserrat style). Generous whitespace. Render every piece of text EXACTLY as written, spelled correctly, with straight apostrophes; numbers use spaces as thousand separators. No other text, no logos, no brand marks, no watermarks.
notes: Normalar: pochta 100 $/oy, kuryer 200 $/oy (VM 244, BRIEF.md). Bojxona qiymati = tovar + yo'l. Minimal 3 $/kg qo'llanmadi. Hisob: (150.0 − 100) × 30 % = 15.0 $ × 11897.9 = 178468 so'm + BKO 110000.
